info.title: VaaniEHR API
info.description: Research prototype. Simulated data only. Standalone mode: access token about 1 hour, no refresh token (ADR-D4). Generated from the route registry; do not edit by hand (npm run openapi).

post.summary: Sign in with e-mail and password; returns a ~1 h access token (no refresh token)

Register a patient (an existing phone number in the clinic returns the existing patient)

get.summary: This clinic's audit log, newest first. Admin sees full rows; researcher sees anonymised rows. Rows with no clinic (seed, failed logins for unknown e-mails) are not shown.
Re-compute the whole hash chain and report whether it is intact. The chain is shared by all clinics, so the answer carries no row counts or hashes; use `npm run verify:audit` for those.
